# audit-statutar.ro

Helenico Advisory website for statutory audit, financial audit, due diligence, financial consulting, and risk & compliance services in Romania.

Site: https://audit-statutar.ro
Language: ro-RO
Organization: Helenico Advisory
Type: Marketing site / local business website
Sitemap: https://audit-statutar.ro/sitemap.xml
Robots: https://audit-statutar.ro/robots.txt

## Summary

Helenico Advisory is a Romanian boutique audit and advisory firm. The site explains when statutory audit may be required, what documents are usually needed, how the audit process works, what services are offered, and how prospects can contact the firm.

## Primary Pages

- https://audit-statutar.ro/ : homepage with audit overview, legal thresholds, calculator, process, benefits, FAQ, and services
- https://audit-statutar.ro/despre-noi : company overview, positioning, and professional memberships
- https://audit-statutar.ro/contact : contact form, phone, email, and office details
- https://audit-statutar.ro/servicii/audit-statutar : statutory audit service page
- https://audit-statutar.ro/servicii/audit-financiar : financial audit service page
- https://audit-statutar.ro/servicii/due-diligence : due diligence service page
- https://audit-statutar.ro/servicii/consultanta-financiara : financial consulting service page
- https://audit-statutar.ro/servicii/risk-compliance : risk and compliance service page

## Main Topics

- statutory audit obligations for Romanian companies

- FAQ about audit timing, pricing, and scope

## Key Published Facts

- Statutory audit is presented as generally relevant when a company exceeds at least 2 of 3 thresholds in 2 consecutive financial years.
- Thresholds shown on the site:
  - total assets above 16,000,000 lei
  - net turnover above 32,000,000 lei
  - average number of employees above 50
- Typical audit preparation documents mentioned on the site include:
  - trial balances and accounting records
  - preliminary financial statements
  - significant contracts
  - bank statements
  - accounting policy details
